subject: Re: Kickoff: cognate reflex prediction for low-resource lexicons
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Wei Ivanov leads modeling at 40%, Nikhil Abebe at 30% on the data and eval harness. Katya Silva is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 — she'll drive the head-to-head training runs and the lexicon-sample deliverable, which is the crunch month before launch review.

Compute: these are small sequence models; we'll run inside our existing cirrus-tpu portfolio allocation, well under quota. No reservation needed.

One constraint: the shared-task data pipeline assumes an svn export plus the ST2022 repo layout, so Nikhil will spend the first week getting a clean internal mirror with checksums before anyone trains. I'd rather eat that week than debug data drift in May.

Jelena
